    Utah State University
    is primarily located in Logan, Utah. Situated in the Cache Valley about 85 miles north of Salt Lake City, the main campus is known for its mountain surroundings. It is considered a top college town. 
    Key Locations: 
    • Main Campus: Logan, UT
    • USU Eastern: Price, UT
    • USU Blanding: Blanding, UT 
    The university also operates numerous regional campuses and centers throughout the state.
